properties.comment: Lake Region Electric will have a planned power outage, today, Thursday, November 19th, beginning at approximately 10:30 am and will last until approximately 1 pm.   Crews will be working on the Northeast side of the Britton Golf Course.   If you work from home or have a medical condition that requires electricity we request that you relocate during the outage time or use backup generation.  We appreciate your patience.   Thank you.
